registration.positivity: rho>=rho_Plummer*(1-20 L^2/(7 a^2)); positive for L/a<sqrt(7/20). Total mass M.
registration.boundary: isolated regular source, no point mass or growing homogeneous field
registration.scope: 81 parameter/source combinations, diagnostic only. Source construction depends on L; this is not an unchanged-source parameter comparison or an observational fit.

limitations: Finite radius samples cannot prove inward force everywhere. Tail beyond r+40L is truncated, not rigorously bounded here. No equilibrium or dynamical test.
